mapper.sql: select id, phone, window_number, satisfaction_select, reason_select, suggestion, is_gift, address, create_time, update_time from questionnaire_info
mapper.select: select q.*, qg.id as gift_id, qg.gift_number, qg.phone as gift_phone, qg.gift_address, qg.questionnaire_id, qg.gift_time, qg.create_time as gift_create_time, qg.update_time as gift_update_time from questionnaire_info q left join questionnaire_gift_info qg on q.id = qg.questionnaire_id where q.id = #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT satisfactions.satisfaction_select as satisfactionSelect, IFNULL(qis.count,0) as count FROM ( SELECT 1 AS satisfaction_select UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 ) AS satisfactions LEFT JOIN ( SELECT count(*) as count, satisfaction_select FROM questionnaire_info GROUP BY satisfaction_select ORDER BY satisfaction_select ) AS qis ON satisfactions.satisfaction_select = qis.satisfaction_select ORDER BY satisfactionSelect
